title: Person: Mr Casey
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Mr Casey

anchor.prefix: ere he had seen that the fingers could not be straightened out: and Mr Casey had told him that he had got those three cramped fingers making a birthday present for Queen Victoria.
anchor.suffix:
tapped the gland of his neck and smiled at Stephen with sleepy eyes: and Mr Dedalus said to him:

 —Yes. Well now, that’s all right. O, we had a good walk, hadn’t we, John? Yes...
